Alright so I'm seeing a lot of poor quality content here recently

I get that there may be two sides to this - those who want to share content who sincerely feel the community will enjoy. But then there are those who may be submitting random un-funny pictures just for the sake of gaining points. Please, don't do this...

One of the biggest problems with the subreddit was that it turned into a catch-all for random pictures -- many which were not funny, not interesting, or just outright poor quality (Tumblr threads, viral images your grandma would email) often people would post these for easy karma.

Please consider before posting: Is this funny? Is this quality? Would I upvote this?

If none of these true then your submission doesn't belong on /v/funny.

I feel like people need to be taught how to submit quality content and how to properly downvote/upvote... For example, the fact that images and memes can be quickly processed in your brain and lead to more upvotes compared to a text article. A lot of us know this but we still upvote images faster and more frequently. Perhaps we need to be taught to recognize things like this. Maybe a voating 101 course!
